AWARD/JUDGMENT FACTUAL POSITION & PLEADINGS 1.
This DAR was filed on 13.12.2018 by Investigation Officer (IO) before my Ld. Predecessor.

The DAR was prepared by IO in respect of a motor vehicular accident which occurred at about 19.26 hrs on 23.01.2018 at a spot situated near Cremation Ground, Pushta, near Pradhan Colony, Burari,
Delhi in which one Raj Kishor Thakur S/o Sh. Sidhu Thakur (hereinafter referred to as "deceased")
lost his life.

As per DAR, at the relevant time the deceased was riding a TractorTrolley to his home when the driver of the said TractorTrolley lost control over the same and drove it off the road at the spot of accident, whereafter the TractorTrolley turned turtle leading to Digitally signed by LOVLEEN LOVLEEN Date:
2023.04.21 14:39:20 +0530 fatal injuries on the person of two of the riders (passengers), including the deceased, and grievous injuries to two riders (passengers).
The driver of the TractorTrolley also lost his life in the said accident.
The registration number of the Tractor is PB11AR9824 (hereinafter referred to as "offending vehicle").
An FIR no. 42/18 PS Burari was registered on the basis of a DD No. 47 (A) dated 23.01.2018 (vide the said DD information regarding occurrence of above accident was conveyed to the PS).
After due investigation an abated charge sheet was filed against the driver of the offending vehicle U/s 279/337/338/304A Vuchiya Devi vs Mact No. 1057/18 Vuchiya Devi & Ors.

3 IPC.
The present DAR was treated as a 'claim petition' by the Ld. Predecessor of this Tribunal vide orders dated 13.12.2018.
The petitioners are the widow, two minor sons and the mother of the deceased.

R1 is the driver of the offending vehicle ( who also lost his life in the above accident and whose LRs were not impleaded by the petitioners in the present proceedings) and R2 is stated to be the owner of the same.
R2 was directed to file his Written Statement.

Petitioners were also directed to file statement of facts in the prescribed Form G.
2.
No Written statement was filed by R-2.
Accordingly, the right of the R-2 to file written statement was closed vide order dated 24.03.2021.
EVIDENCE 3.
In support of their contentions, the petitioners examined petitioner no. 1 Smt. Vuchiya Devi as PW-1.

PW-1, vide her affidavit Ex. PW1/A, deposed that she is the widow of the deceased who sustained fatal LOVLEEN 2023.04.21 injuries in the accident dated 23.01.2018 as detailed in Para No. 1 of this award.
She further deposed that deceased was aged about 29 years at the time of his death and is survived by all the petitioners herein.
She further deposed that the accident took place due to rashness and negligence of R-1.

Ex. PW1/X(OSR) is the photocopy of Aadhar Card of son of PW-1 namely Ankit;
Ex. PW1/Y(OSR) is the photocopy of Aadhar Card of son of PW-1 namely Ankush Thakur;

Ex. PW1/Z(OSR) is the photocopy of Aadhar Card of Smt. Sita Devi;
Ex. PW1/Z-1(OSR) is the photocopy of Aadhar Card of deceased."
She was not cross examined by either of the respondents.
3.1 No evidence was lead in defence by the respondent.

CONVERSION OF CLAIM PETITION U/S 163A MV ACT 4.
After the conclusion of evidence, on 20.03.2023, an application was moved for converting the petition into one u/s 163A MV Act.
The said application was allowed and the present petition was treated as one filed u/s 163A MV Act vide order dated 20/03/2023.
FINDINGS 5.
Oral submissions have been advanced by Advocate Ms. Nisha Satyarthi, on behalf of the petitioners.

6. We may note here that the DAR Ex PW1/7 (Colly), which is relied upon by PW-1, reflects that the deceased lost his life when the offending vehicle being driven by R-1 (since deceased) turned turtle.
R-2 has not bothered to contest the conclusions drawn in the DAR and the chargesheet available on record, nor has he bothered to lead any evidence to the contrary.

7. In view of the above discussion, this Tribunal holds that the deceased lost his life on 23.01.2018 in a motor vehicular accident on account of use of offending vehicle, which was being driven by R-1 (since deceased) at the relevant time.
Digitally signed by LOVLEEN LOVLEEN Date:

As the fatal accident has arisen out of the use of offending vehicle, accordingly, as per Second Schedule annexed to M.V. Act, prior to the Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, compensation to the tune of Rs. 5,00,000/- is admissible to the petitioners.

The petitioners are also entitled to be granted a sum of Rs. 20,000/- each towards funeral expenses and loss of estate in terms of propositions laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Rajwati @ Rajjo & Ors.

Vs.
United India Insurance Co. Ltd., Civil Appeal No. 8179/2022 decided on 09/12/2022.
The petitioners are also entitled to be granted a sum of Rs. 44,000/- each towards consortium.

The petitioners are thus awarded a sum of Rs.7,16,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs Sixteen Thousand only)
(Rs. 5,00,000/- + Rs. 1,76,000/- (44,000X4) + Rs. 20,000/- + Rs. 20,000/-) on account of the untimely death of the deceased due to a motor vehicular accident dated 23.01.2018.
RELIEF 9.
The petitioners are thus awarded a sum of Rs.7,16,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs Sixteen Thousand only) along with interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of DAR i.e 13/12/2018.
However, it is directed that the amount of interim award, shall be excluded from the above amount and calculations of compensation.

An FIR no. 42/18 PS Burari was registered on the basis of a DD No. 47 (A) dated 23.01.2018 (vide the said DD information regarding occurrence of above accident was conveyed to the PS).
Accordingly, the right of the R-2 to file written statement was closed vide order dated 24.03.2021.
She was not cross examined by either of the respondents.
3.1 No evidence was lead in defence by the respondent.
After the conclusion of evidence, on 20.03.2023, an application was moved for converting the petition into one u/s 163A MV Act.
The said application was allowed and the present petition was treated as one filed u/s 163A MV Act vide order dated 20/03/2023.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: R-2 has not bothered to contest the conclusions drawn in the DAR and the chargesheet available on record, nor has he bothered to lead any evidence to the contrary.
opennyai_summary.decision:
7. In view of the above discussion, this Tribunal holds that the deceased lost his life on 23.01.2018 in a motor vehicular accident on account of use of offending vehicle, which was being driven by R-1 (since deceased) at the relevant time.
As the fatal accident has arisen out of the use of offending vehicle, accordingly, as per Second Schedule annexed to M.V. Act, prior to the Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, compensation to the tune of Rs. 5,00,000/- is admissible to the petitioners.
The petitioners are also entitled to be granted a sum of Rs. 20,000/- each towards funeral expenses and loss of estate in terms of propositions laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Rajwati @ Rajjo & Ors.
The petitioners are also entitled to be granted a sum of Rs. 44,000/- each towards consortium.
The petitioners are thus awarded a sum of Rs.7,16,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs Sixteen Thousand only)
(Rs. 5,00,000/- + Rs. 1,76,000/- (44,000X4) + Rs. 20,000/- + Rs. 20,000/-) on account of the untimely death of the deceased due to a motor vehicular accident dated 23.01.2018.
The petitioners are thus awarded a sum of Rs.7,16,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs Sixteen Thousand only) along with interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of DAR i.e 13/12/2018.
However, it is directed that the amount of interim award, shall be excluded from the above amount and calculations of compensation.
R-2 is the owner of the offending vehicle and also being vicariously liable for the acts of R-1, is liable to pay the awarded amount of compensation to petitioners.
Ahlmad is directed to send the copy of the award to Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate concerned and Delhi Legal Services Authority in view of Central Motor Vehicles (fifth Amendment) Rules, 2022 [(Directions at serial nos. 39, 40 of Procedure for Investigation of Motor Vehicle Accidents (under Rule 150A)].
14. Ahlmad is further directed to comply with the directions passed by the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in MAC APP No. 10/2021 titled as New India Assurance Company Ltd. Vs. Sangeeta Vaid &
Ors., date of decision :
06.01.2021 regarding digitisation of the records.
